First result: held through backpressure, then accepted in order
INT32 data and tags are held while result valid=1 and ready=0. Each accepted beat matches the independent oracle.
Simulation clock stimulus does not establish FPGA timing closure. Memory, command driver and consumer are testbench stand-ins.
